objective: Design and deliver an Achievements Framework that supports schema-driven achievements, runtime evaluation, persistence, and tooling for designers.

steps.title: Discovery & Schema
steps.description: Define achievement.schema.json and map reward types to systems.

steps.title: Data Representation
steps.description: Create serializable C# model and ScriptableObject authoring type for achievements.

steps.title: Evaluation Dispatcher
steps.description: Implement AchievementEvaluator to subscribe to events and evaluate criteria.

steps.title: Persistence & Integration
steps.description: Store unlocked achievements and progress in the save system; provide migrations.

steps.title: Editor Tools
steps.description: Editor import/validation window and preview tooling for designers.

steps.title: Sample Content
steps.description: Ship 5 sample achievement ScriptableObjects under Assets/Content/Achievements/.

steps.title: QA & Docs
steps.description: Run unit tests and a quick playtest; document usage and links.

notes: Use [Serializable] for data models and ScriptableObject for designer assets.
Reference Assets/docs/requirements.md for fine-grained criteria and progression rules.
Keep evaluator logic separate from Unity-specific event subscriptions for testability.
